DayOff Mate (연차메이트) Without sign-in, records stay on your phone

DayOff Mate Privacy Policy

Effective November 22, 2026 · App: DayOff Mate (연차메이트) · Package com.blessingq.dayoffmate · Developer: JAEYOUNG LEE (blessingq)

This English version is a translation provided for convenience. If it differs from the Korean version, the Korean version prevails.

At a glance

  • If you use the app without signing in, your hire date, leave records and notes are stored only on your phone and never sent to the developer's servers.
  • If you sign in, your records are stored in Google Firebase (Seoul region) so you can continue on another phone and share days off with your groups.
  • Groups only see what you choose to share. Notes, hire date and day adjustments are never shared.
  • Calendar events are read and written only on your phone. Google Drive auto-backup is saved in your own Google Drive; the developer cannot receive or see it.
  • We send crash reports and usage statistics to fix bugs and improve features. You can turn usage statistics off in Settings.

JAEYOUNG LEE (blessingq, the “developer”) processes the personal information of people who use the mobile app DayOff Mate (연차메이트, package com.blessingq.dayoffmate, the “app”) in accordance with the Korean Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) and related laws, and publishes this policy under Article 30 of PIPA. It applies to the Android app and the future iOS app.

1. Purposes of processing

  1. Sign-up and account management: verifying sign-in (Kakao, Naver, Google; Apple on iOS), confirming you are 14 or older, recording consent to the Terms, deleting accounts, answering inquiries and verifying identity
  2. Sync: storing your leave settings, records, day adjustments and settings in your account so you can use them on another phone
  3. Groups: creating, inviting and joining groups, showing your days off to group members at the level you choose, finding common days off, and (if you allow it) letting people find you by your ID
  4. Notifications: sending push notifications about group members' days off and join requests. Your own leave and expiry reminders are scheduled on your phone and do not go through the server.
  5. Reliability and security: finding the cause of crashes, checking requests come from the genuine app, preventing abuse (rate limits), remote configuration (maintenance notices, feature switches, holiday data updates)
  6. Improvement: per-feature usage statistics (when “Send usage statistics” is on)
  7. Advertising: a home-screen banner ad that keeps the app free (in versions that show ads)
  8. User protection: handling reports and violations of the Terms

2. Information we process and how we collect it

2.1 Without signing in

There is no account and nothing personal is stored on the developer's servers. Your hire date, leave basis, workplace size, workplace type, weekend setting, leave records (type, date, AM/PM, hours, note), day adjustments and app settings are stored only on your phone. Section 2.4 (automatically generated information) applies whether or not you sign in.

2.2 When you sign in (required)

Stored on the server for signed-in users
CategoryItems
AccountSign-in provider identifier (Kakao member number, Naver member identifier, Google or Apple account identifier), app user ID (uid), email address (from Google or Apple, or from Naver if provided; Kakao sign-in does not provide an email), sign-in method, sign-up time, times you confirmed being 14+, accepted the Terms and gave first sharing consent
Leave settingsHire date, leave basis (hire date, fiscal year, or days-off only), fiscal year start month, rounding, workplace size, workplace type, whether you rest on weekends and holidays, hourly leave settings
RecordsLeave records (type, date, AM/PM, hours, note, hidden-from-groups flag, created/updated time), day adjustments (period, days, reason, note)
NotificationsGroup leave notification settings (on/off, days before, time), per-device push token (FCM), platform (Android/iOS), notification permission status, app language (used only to choose the notification language)

Your email is used only for account management (answering inquiries, verifying identity). It is never shown in the app or to groups and never used for marketing. The app does not save the provider's name or profile photo as app data. However, for Google and Apple sign-in, the authentication service (Firebase Authentication) may keep the basic profile passed by the provider (name, profile photo URL) in its sign-in record; the app does not use it on screen or in groups.

2.3 When you use groups

  • Nickname (required), ID (optional), whether others may find you by ID
  • Group name and type, members and roles, join time, pending join requests
  • Per-group sharing level (days only / with leave types), whether to show remaining leave, per-group notification setting
  • Shared information shown to the group (dates off with full day/AM/PM/partial; depending on your level, leave type and hours; if enabled, remaining leave and its as-of date)
  • Invitations sent and received, block list, group activity log (joined, left, removed, owner changed, including nicknames)
  • Reports, if you file one

2.4 Automatically generated or collected (all users)

2.5 When you contact us

Your email address, the content of your message, and identity details you provide such as sign-in method and nickname.

How we collect it

You enter it in the app; we receive it from the sign-in provider; it is generated while you use the app; or you send it by email.

3. Information processed only on your phone

The following stays on your phone (or in your own Google account). The developer cannot receive or see it.

  • Records of users who do not sign in: everything in section 2.1.
  • Calendar events: if you turn on “Add days off to calendar” or “Show calendar events”, the app reads and writes your phone's calendar on the phone only. Events are never sent to or stored on our servers, and never included in groups, usage statistics, crash reports or backups. Events the app adds are titled just “Day off” (no leave type); notes are added only if you turn on “Include notes” (never for health leave). By default events go into a “DayOff Mate” calendar that exists only on this phone. If you choose a calendar from another account such as Google, those events sync with that service under its policy.
  • Google Drive auto-backup (for users who are not signed in and turn it on): your records are saved in a hidden, app-only space (the app data folder) in your own Google Drive, sent directly from your phone to your Drive without passing through our servers. The developer cannot receive or see them. One file per day is kept for the last 14 days; a file contains your hire date, leave settings, leave records (including notes) and day adjustments. The Google account email used for backup is stored only on your phone. See section 4.
  • Exported backup files: saved or sent to the place you choose (phone storage, your cloud, a messenger). Files contain your hire date, records and notes, so do not send them to others.
  • Home widgets and your own reminders: created and scheduled on the phone.
  • Invite QR scanning: the camera image is used on the phone only to read the QR code and is not saved or sent.
  • Phone backups: if Android auto-backup or device-to-device transfer is on, the operating system may copy the app's records to your Google account backup or a new phone. This is an operating-system feature; the developer has no access.

4. Google user data (Google API Services User Data Policy)

  • Scope requested: when you turn on Google Drive auto-backup, the app requests only https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.appdata. This scope only gives access to the hidden app folder DayOff Mate creates; the app cannot see or change any other files in your Drive. Google sign-in receives only basic profile information such as your account identifier and email.
  • Use: only to save backup files, list backups with their record counts, restore a backup you choose, and delete backups older than 14 days. Google sign-in information is used only to identify and manage your account.
  • Transfer and sharing: Drive data moves only between your phone and your Google Drive. It is not sent to the developer's servers or to any third party, not used for advertising, marketing, credit assessment or sale, and not read by humans. It is not used to develop, improve or train generalized AI or machine-learning models.
  • Limited Use: DayOff Mate's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
  • Turning off and deleting: turn off auto-backup in the app under Settings > Backup (files already saved stay in your Drive). Delete saved files in Google Drive on the web: Settings > Manage apps > DayOff Mate > Options > “Delete hidden app data”. Revoke access in your Google Account under Third-party apps & services.

5. Retention and deletion

We delete personal information without delay once its purpose is fulfilled or its retention period ends. When you delete your account, your account data on the server is deleted without delay; the items below are deleted automatically after the periods shown.

Retention periods
InformationRetention
Account, leave settings, records, group dataUntil you delete your account
Individually deleted records and adjustmentsKept as a “deleted” marker so other phones learn of the deletion; permanently removed within 30 days
Accounts that signed in but did not finish sign-upDeleted after 24 hours
Invite codes and links / ID invitations / pending join requestsDeleted after 48 hours / 14 days / 7 days
Group activity log, records of removed membersDeleted after 30 days
Device push tokensDeleted on sign-out or account deletion, or when the token becomes invalid
Retry data for unlinking a sign-in provider (provider identifier)Only if unlinking failed during account deletion, until unlinking succeeds
Server backups for disaster recoveryUp to 7 days
Firebase Authentication recordsRemoved from Google's backup systems within 180 days after account deletion (access IP logs: a few weeks)
Crash reports (Crashlytics)90 days
Usage statistics (Google Analytics)The retention period set in Google Analytics (up to 14 months)
Firebase installation IDPer Google Firebase policy; removed from Google's systems within 180 days after a deletion request
Inquiry and deletion-request emails1 year after the request is handled

No information currently has to be kept under other laws. If paid features are introduced and records such as payment history must be kept, we will update this policy.

How we delete: data is deleted by server functions (automatic expiry policies and the account-deletion function) when its period ends or when you ask; electronic files are deleted so they cannot be recovered. We keep no paper records. Information that exists only on your phone can be deleted with “Delete all records” in the app or by uninstalling the app.

6. Sharing with third parties and group visibility

The developer does not provide or sell your personal information to third parties, except where required by law or requested by investigative authorities through legal procedures.

Groups show information to members of the same group based on the consent you give when you first create or join a group (“I agree to show the information above to members of this group”).

Group visibility
RecipientsInformation shownPurposePeriod
Members of groups you join (up to 30 per group) Nickname, group role, dates off with full day/AM/PM/partial. With “with leave types”, leave type and hours. With “show remaining leave”, remaining leave and its as-of date. Only records from 12 months ago to 24 months ahead. Seeing days off together, finding common days off, group leave notifications Until you leave or are removed, or the group or your account is deleted
  • Notes, hire date and tenure, leave basis, day adjustments, expiry dates, workplace size and type, email and sign-in method are never shared. Health leave always appears only as “Day off”. Turning on “Hide from groups” on a record removes it from all groups.
  • Group owners cannot see beyond the level each member chose.
  • If a member turns on group leave notifications, the information you share may also appear in their phone notifications (including the lock screen).
  • After you leave a group or it is deleted, information may remain briefly in other members' app caches.
  • If you turn on “Let others find me by ID”, people who know your exact ID can find and invite you.
  • When you invite via KakaoTalk or the share sheet, your nickname, the group name and the invite code or link are sent by you through the app you choose.

9. Advertising

In versions that show ads, one banner ad is shown on the home screen through Google AdMob. Widgets and the calendar and backup screens have no ads. Google may process the advertising ID and app usage information to serve ads, cap frequency, measure performance, prevent fraud and (where permitted) personalize ads. The developer does not use this information to identify you. On Android you can delete or reset your advertising ID under Settings > Privacy (or Google) > Ads; on iOS you can turn off tracking under Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking. See how Google uses information for ads.

10. App permissions

All app permissions are optional; if you decline, everything else keeps working. When you turn on a feature, the app explains it first and then opens the system permission dialog.

Optional permissions
PermissionUsed forIf declined
CalendarAdding and updating your days off in the phone calendar; showing phone calendar events in the app calendar. Events are read and written only on the phone.Only these two features are unavailable. “Add to calendar app” on each record works without the permission.
CameraScanning invite QR codesEnter the invite code manually.
NotificationsYour leave, leave expiry, group member leave and join request notificationsYou just won't get notifications.

You can change permissions any time in your phone settings > Apps > DayOff Mate > Permissions, and turn off calendar features in the app under Settings > Calendar. The app also uses normal permissions such as internet access, rescheduling reminders after a reboot, and the advertising ID (versions that show ads).

11. Your rights and how to exercise them

You may at any time ask to access, correct, delete or stop processing your personal information, and withdraw consent.

  • In the app: edit leave settings (Settings > My leave info), change nickname or ID (Settings > Account > Manage account), change sharing level or leave a group (group settings), delete records (Settings > Data > Delete all records), delete your account (Settings > Account > Manage account > Delete account), turn off usage statistics (Settings > About > Send usage statistics).
  • By email: write to ejok9194@gmail.com. After verifying your identity we will act without delay (within 10 days) and tell you the result. Account deletion requests are handled within 7 days as described on the account deletion page.
  • You may also act through a legal representative or an authorized person; we may ask for a power of attorney.
  • If the law requires us to refuse or limit a request, we will tell you why.
  • The app's leave calculation is done on your phone for your reference; the developer makes no automated decisions about you.

12. Children under 14

People under 14 cannot sign up (sign in). If you choose “I'm under 14” on the sign-up screen, the sign-in information received is deleted immediately. You can still use the record features without signing in; in that case no personal information is collected other than the automatically generated information in section 2.4. If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child under 14, we delete it without delay.

13. Security measures

  • Administrative: minimizing the information processed (e.g. only the member number from Kakao); access to admin consoles limited to the developer
  • Technical: encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest (Google Cloud default encryption); security rules so only you can read your data and only members can read group data; server rules that reject notes or health-leave types in shared data; App Check so only the genuine app can make requests; rate limits on sign-in, invite codes and ID search; support for hiding notification content on the lock screen
  • Physical: servers and data are protected by the physical security of Google's data centers (processor)

14. Cookies and similar technologies

The app does not use cookies; it uses the device identifiers in section 2.4 (Firebase installation ID, app instance ID, advertising ID). You can turn off usage statistics in the app and reset the advertising ID in your phone settings. This website (blessingq.github.io/dayoffmate) uses no cookies or visitor tracking.

16. Changes to this policy

If we change this policy, we will announce it on this page and in the app at least 7 days before it takes effect (30 days for changes that significantly affect your rights). Earlier versions are available in this site's public repository history.
